name: Odor Eliminator

features.lead: Many uses other than automotive, I.E
features.text: offices, home, rest rooms, boats and airplanes.

description: SPECIALLY FORMULATED TO: Effectively remove foul odors trapped in carpeting, upholstery, fabric and many other surfaces. MOC® Odor Eliminator™ immediately starts to neutralize odors on contact, leaving behind a pleasant scent. Helps remove odors left by pets, tobacco, body odor, mildew, urine and other organic sources. Designed for use in vehicles, boats, airplanes, homes and offices.
application: Directions: 1. Shake can well before each application. 2. Hold can 6–8 inches from affected area. 3. Spray a fine mist onto entire area. 4. For tough odors, spray a generous amount of Odor Eliminator™ directly on the source. Note: MOC® Odor Eliminator™ must make contact with the source of the odor to neutralize it.
